fieldNotes.truckGate: Open campus layout - plant set back behind broad grass buffers, no perimeter fence or controlled checkpoint visible from public-road Street View. Classified no gate.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth observed anywhere along the public-road frontage; office building with a Campbell's monument sign at the SW corner.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Large trailer parking with rows of parked trailers along the west side of the plant.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: Dock banks on the west and around the main plant building; ~45 estimate banded 25-50, low confidence.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Multiple buildings - main pretzel/snack plant, separate office building SW, additional industrial structures NE.
fieldNotes.drivewayShort: Short internal approach from the access road to the dock aprons.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Derived from perimeter box ~610m N-S x ~610m E-W; excludes the separate solar farm to the south.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur into the property; adjacent solar farm occupies the land to the south.
